baseline_rules: Do not mix evidence from different silicon revisions in one equivalence verdict.
Prefer exact-target generated configuration and DTS data over family-generic configuration when both exist.
Record exact boot artifacts and their cryptographic hashes for hardware and twin runs.
Record exact System Manager configuration because resource ownership and SCMI exposure are policy-dependent.
Treat production firmware binaries as inputs to qualification, not as undocumented constants embedded in the model.
Update this baseline through review whenever an authoritative source revision changes.
